title: Ложный больничный и паника на кухне  (The Fake Sick Leave and Kitchen Panic)

segments.t: After Katya leaves, Eleonora instructs Mikhail to tell the St. Petersburg chef to stay home on fake sick leave, while down in the kitchen Barinov tells his stunned crew that his ex-wife owns the hotel. Listen to the scene.
Завтра шеф должен быть на больничном.
Просто позвони и скажи ему.
Пусть их шеф посидит дома.
Виктор Петрович, что случилось?
Да так, одна маленькая мелочь.
Моя бывшая жена — хозяйка этого отеля.
Шеф, всё будет хорошо.
Сейчас попрощаемся, выпьем, и всё будет хорошо.
Мы же пришли сюда за вами!
Не бойтесь, вы сами справитесь.
Она выгонит нас, чтобы вас унизить.
Никто вас здесь не тронет.
А я недавно большой кредит взял.
Теперь придётся шубу жены вернуть.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Завтра шеф должен быть на больничном.
'Tomorrow the chef must be on sick leave.' Adding that tomorrow the must be on sick leave fills in the missing piece for Barinov.
Просто позвони и скажи ему.
'Just call and tell him.' With the kitchen and hotel in play, Eleonora keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Пусть их шеф посидит дома.
'Let their chef stay at home.' Noting that Barinov should let their stay at home keeps Eleonora's side of the story simple and clear.
Виктор Петрович, что случилось?
'Victor Petrovich, what happened?' With the moment and hotel hanging in the air, Senya puts Barinov on the spot.
Да так, одна маленькая мелочь.
'Oh, just one small trifle.' With the hotel and shift in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Моя бывшая жена — хозяйка этого отеля.

'My ex-wife is the owner of this hotel.' Because his ex wife is the owner of this hotel, Barinov treats the matter as settled. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Шеф, всё будет хорошо.
'Chef, everything will be fine.' Explaining that everything will be fine lays the cards on the table for Barinov.
Сейчас попрощаемся, выпьем, и всё будет хорошо.
'Right now we will say goodbye, have a drink, and all will be fine.' Barinov mentions that right now they will say goodbye have a drink and all will be fine so Eleonora sees what is at stake.
Мы же пришли сюда за вами!

'We came here following you, after all!' Senya declares that they came here following Barinov after all as the tension in the room peaks. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
Не бойтесь, вы сами справитесь.
'Do not be afraid, you will manage on your own.' Mentioning that do not be afraid Eleonora will manage on Eleonora's own moves the talk in a new direction.
Она выгонит нас, чтобы вас унизить.

'She will kick us out to humiliate you.' Senya explains that she will kick them out to humiliate Barinov, keeping his voice calm and direct. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
Никто вас здесь не тронет.

'Nobody here will touch you.' Realizing that nobody here will touch Eleonora changes how Barinov handles the situation. Russian stacks "never" or "nothing" together with "not", doubling the refusal for extra weight.
А я недавно большой кредит взял.
'And I recently took out a big loan.' Noting that he recently took out a big loan keeps Senya's side of the story simple and clear.
Теперь придётся шубу жены вернуть.

'Now I will have to return my wife's fur coat.' Even though he will have to return his wife fur coat, Senya keeps a steady face in front of Barinov. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.

Она выгонит нас, чтобы вас унизить.

А я недавно большой кредит взял.
Теперь придётся шубу жены вернуть.
And that shows the panic on the kitchen line as Fedya worries about his loan and Senya worries about Marina's fur coat. See you next time!
Хорошего дня!
